models_evaluated: AI admission prediction algorithm using triage notes

links.outcome: Real-time accuracy of deployed admission prediction AI versus original performance
links.effect: Live sensitivity 73.1%, specificity 74.3%, PPV 50%, NPV 88.7%, accuracy 74%; real-time tool became less accurate than the original.
links.quote: Our study showed the diagnostic evaluation of a real-time AI clinical decision-support tool became less accurate than the original.

links.outcome: Accuracy variation across admission destinations after deployment
links.effect: Accuracy lowest for psychiatric unit admission (34%), highest for gastroenterology (84%) and medical admission (80%).
links.quote: The accuracy of the system was at the lowest for admission to psychiatric units (34%) and at the highest for gastroenterology and medical admission (84% and 80%, respectively).

screen.reason: The study evaluates the diagnostic performance and accuracy decay of a predictive machine learning tool after real-time clinical deployment in an emergency department, without testing a specific organizational guardrail or deployment practice.
